principles: Authenticate only protected server reads that require the customer key.
Do not translate transport success into Authority completion.
Make the regression visible in focused smoke tests.
drivers: Staging protected job status currently returns 401 from CLI without Authorization.
Customer API keys are already resolved from env/path/trust env for server-backed Authority traffic.
Authority completion is a separate receipt plus quorum condition.

options.name: authenticated-protected-get-option
pros: Fixes the reported 401 on protected job verdict/status reads
Keeps policy discovery keyless via an explicit option
cons: Requires a small GET helper API change

options.name: add-auth-to-all-get-requests
cons: Would send customer key to policy discovery and blur public discovery vs protected reads

rationale: Protected job status reads need the customer key, but policy discovery should remain unauthenticated and completion semantics must remain unchanged.

preMortem.scenario: Policy discovery starts sending customer keys
preMortem.trigger: The fix adds auth headers globally to all GET calls
preMortem.consequence: Public discovery no longer stays keyless and leaks credentials unnecessarily
preMortem.mitigation: Use an explicit authenticated GET option and keep discoverPolicy tests asserting no Authorization

preMortem.scenario: Status reports fullAuthorityDone from a successful read
preMortem.trigger: Regression test only checks 200/Authorization and ignores receipt/quorum flags
preMortem.consequence: CLI could overclaim completion when server still has zero verdicts or no receipt
preMortem.mitigation: Add smoke assertions for blocked/fullAuthorityDone=false without verified receipt/quorum

preMortem.scenario: Missing customer key causes confusing network 401 instead of local fail-closed
preMortem.trigger: Protected read path silently omits key or does not test absence behavior
preMortem.consequence: Developers cannot distinguish missing config from server rejection
preMortem.mitigation: Keep auth resolution explicit and cover the presence path for configured keys without changing local fallback
